The 2005–06 season was [[Real Madrid CF]]'s 75th season in [[La Liga]]. This article lists all matches that the club played in the 2005–06 season, and also shows statistics of the club's players.

For the second consecutive season, Real Madrid did not win any competitions. This was their first consecutive trophyless seasons since [[1982–83 Real Madrid CF season|1982–83]] to [[1983–84 Real Madrid CF season|1983–84]].

==Competitions==
===Pre-season===
In June 2005, president [[Florentino Pérez]] presented the "2005 Real Madrid World Tour", which included 6 friendly matches in North America and Asia.<ref>{{cite news |title=Florentino Pérez presenta el 'Real Madrid World Tour 2005' |trans-title=Florentino Pérez presents the '2005 Real Madrid World Tour' |url=https://cadenaser.com/ser/2005/06/30/deportes/1120087691_850215.html |access-date=16 August 2022 |work=[[Cadena SER]] |date=30 June 2005 |location=[[Madrid]] |language=es}}</ref> Two more matches were played in [[Central Europe]] during the second stage of the pre-season, including a homage to [[Ferenc Puskás]], which was held in Hungary.<ref>{{cite news |title=El Real Madrid continúa su pretemporada en Austria |trans-title=Real Madrid continues their pre-season in Austria |url=https://cadenaser.com/ser/2005/08/02/deportes/1122938897_850215.html |access-date=21 August 2022 |work=[[Cadena SER]] |date=2 August 2005 |language=es}}</ref> The last match, an annual [[Trofeo Santiago Bernabéu]], was played on home soil.
